name: Ingest Greater
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); transmutation; Level alchemist 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hrs.

DESCRIPTION

This extract allows you to swallow more and larger objects. You may store one object that is the same size category as you, up to three objects one size category smaller, or up to six objects two size categories smaller.

This extract does not allow you to store additional creatures. You may, as a swift action, recover an object or creature by spitting it forth. The object or creature arrives in an adjacent square of your choice.
